# UX Checklist: A task that fails to load shows an error and a retry

**Purpose**: Requirements quality of the overlay panel's load-error and retry state (ST-492).
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. `[x]` means the criterion is satisfied for requirements quality, not that implementation is done.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` = reviewed and satisfied. In this autonomous run the agent reviewed each item against spec.md and plan.md; gaps were fixed in the spec (noted) or the item struck with a reason.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the three body states (loading, failed, shown) and every transition between them specified? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-001, §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for where the focus goes when the retry button disappears on press? [Gap] (fixed: FR-004 now names the fallback to the panel)
- [x] CHK003 Are close requirements stated for both the error state and a retry in flight? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, US2 scenario 4]
- [x] CHK004 Are the failure inputs enumerated (rejection, synchronous throw, non-component value)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK005 Is the catalogue's role in making the state reachable specified, including the per-press behaviour? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Clarification 2]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "shown in the same error pattern as the shared save error" made concrete (element, role, text style, insertion)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK007 Is "on a computer" tied to a decidable rule rather than left to taste? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Plan §Focus]
- [x] CHK008 Is "a non-component" defined by a stated check? [Clarity, Clarification 5]
- [x] CHK009 Are the message and button wording given verbatim in both languages? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Do the busy-mark rules agree across FR-001, FR-004 and the plan's body-state logic? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-004, Plan §Body state]
- [x] CHK011 Is the button-label source consistent between the spec assumption and the plan's new key? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §i18n keys] (spec leaves it to the plan)
- [x] CHK012 Does the focus rule (FR-007) stay consistent with the first-field rule and ST-158's phone rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Clarification 1]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Can SC-001 to SC-004 each be measured by a named test or sweep? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001..004]
- [x] CHK014 Is "no sideways scroll" and the 44 px / 12 px floor measurable at 320 px? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, §SC-003]

## Non-Functional and Edge Cases

- [x] CHK015 Are reduced-motion, 320 px wrapping and repeated-press behaviours specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Are light/dark contrast requirements stated for the error text? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003, Plan §Markup and style (token --mf-red-ink)]
- [x] ~~CHK017 Is an assistive-technology announcement required when a retry starts?~~ Struck: the skeleton is not announced on first load either (157-FR-012); a new announcement is out of scope for this debt task.
- [x] CHK018 Are unbounded retries and the absence of error classification recorded as explicit assumptions? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
